replay_buffer_test: 671-second high-motion recording, concurrent playback advanced 10.54 seconds, no pending chunks or errors
camera_picker_tests: widget selection/fullscreen/refresh/current-device and JS device enumeration passed
camera_swap_tests: browser synthetic streams retained recorder and MSE; replay advanced 3s; failure and timeout unit tests passed
replay_ui_test: Full Flutter UI with synthetic cameras: camera B selection, replay, fullscreen, return to live, reopen replay and seek to camera B passed
ios_compatibility_tests: Capability mocks passed; physical iPhone and ChatGPT in-app browser not yet verified
autofocus_tests: Supported/unsupported cameras, preserved constraints and driver failures passed; optical focus not verified on physical iPhone
tof_tests: Counter regression tests (10 jumps, interpolation, below-line exclusion, interruption, reset) and real worker/model loading passed; actual athletic accuracy not validated
current_validation: All eight JS regression suites and three Flutter tests passed; release build passed
three_minute_test: Synthetic recording observed healthy through 107 seconds; browser automation subsequently became unresponsive, full 180-second retention not verified
tof_phase_tests: Ten JS regression suites passed. Browser synthetic multi-person tracking with pose-array reorder completed ten jumps (10.59s total, 5.28s ascent + 5.31s descent). Point selection and side controls verified. Actual athletics accuracy not verified.
uploaded_video_tests: Real 20s H.264 MP4 decoding/seeking with synthetic pose detections: preparation excluded, first jump at 3.40s, pause held at 4.47s, resumed to ten jumps totaling 10.58s. Ten JS suites passed. Actual athletic pose accuracy not validated.
strict_line_tests: Ten JS regression suites passed. On/below line exclusion, missing and slow samples not bridged, partial measurements flagged, rotated torso and foot landmark outliers tested. Browser synthetic two-person fixture completed ten jumps (10.59s total, 5.31s ascent, 5.28s descent); foot dots and below-line status visually checked. Actual athletic tracking/count accuracy remains unverified without representative video.
body_box_tests: Ten JS regression suites passed, including feet/seat/front/back/hand contact while feet are raised, on-line exclusion, coach exclusion, obscured feet, low-confidence outlier and out-of-frame box handling. Actual athlete video accuracy remains unverified.
silhouette_bed_tests: Ten JS regression suites passed. Real CPU segmentation on provided inverted-athlete screenshot gave a larger head/limb envelope than old torso-only box. Fixed float-mask abort on non-four-pixel-aligned widths. Synthetic browser completed ten flights (10.59s) and nine bed intervals (3.97s). Original continuous athlete footage and phone runtime performance not yet verified.
continuous_focus_tests: Eleven JS suites passed: preparation-flight start, ten cycles with a gap after each confirmed bed contact, active-flight continuity without fabricated timeout landing, partial-time labeling; focus constraints/capture preservation, unsupported and rejected controls, all rotations/mirrors. Browser canvas click sent single-shot and point constraints to a simulated camera. Actual ten-jump footage and optical focus on owner phone remain unverified.
interval_timing_tests: Eleven JS suites passed. Synthetic 0.75s to 10.73s routine with missing detections: 8s flight + 1.98s bed = 9.98s, with unverified classification explicitly flagged. 200 deterministic random-dropout sequences reconciled. Browser ten-flight fixture: 10.59s air + 3.97s bed = 14.56s start-to-end. This fixes discarded elapsed time, not actual pose/transition accuracy; original user video not provided.
sidebar_tracking_tests: Eleven JS regression suites passed, including connected-background rejection and skipping nonselected mask pixels. Mobile 390x844 synthetic UI: sidebar air 10.61s + bed 3.97s = 14.58s for ten jumps. Latest small-person screenshot yielded no pose with both baseline and revised model; desktop warm inference about 55–70ms. Phone speed/accuracy improvement unverified; do not claim real-time scoring solved.
identity_tracking_tests: Eleven JS suites passed, including actual pixel clothing descriptors, bystander rejection, pose reorder, small false torso rejection and long-loss uncertainty. Mobile 390x844 synthetic fixture completed ten flights: 10.66s air + 3.90s bed. Original continuous athlete footage accuracy remains unverified; similar clothing, occlusion and missed poses can still cause incorrect or lost tracking.
tracking_recovery_tests: Eleven regression suites passed, including consecutive matching athlete reacquisition after stale vertical prediction. Mobile 390x844 synthetic fixture completed ten actions with compact buttons below video and score at right. Actual user video counting remains unverified.
full_body_model_tests: Eleven regression suites passed. Full model loaded and returned selected pose and segmentation for inverted-athlete screenshot in real desktop browser. Mobile model selector checked. Continuous user ten-jump video and phone throughput remain unverified.
reference_video_investigation: 12.54s user MOV tested locally at 15 samples/s with fixed initial selection. CPU Lite: 11/188 usable selected bottoms and one flight; Full: 3/188 and zero flights; cropped Full: 21/188 and two flights. Mean worker response 86/109/115ms. GPU trial was faster but did not track reliably and is not released. These are end-to-end tests, not model accuracy scores. Original video not published. Reliable ten-jump live counting remains unresolved.
preview_render_test: 11 regression suites passed; actual desktop browser preview fixture measured 60 draws/s with separate requestAnimationFrame, inference stays bounded to one pending frame.
line_boundary_tests: Eleven regression suites passed. Equality/below is bed, above is air, first takeoff starts immediately, no 150ms duration filter. Mobile 390x844 with original MOV verified right vertical baseline and starting-position slider below video before buttons. Tracking completeness remains unresolved; strict crossings can count noisy boxes.
tracking_note: When connected person mask is missing, the selected pose box is still drawn in green and its bottom edge is used for the strict line test. Pose box may be less accurate; keep visual confirmation. No accuracy claim.
